- **Challenge 2 (Delete-Only Ordinary Command Path):** In [`docs/diary/diary.js`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r197/docs/diary/diary.js#L10534-L10557), `deleteBooking()` issues only dedicated delete proposal requests to `/appointments/proposals/delete/${encodeURIComponent(appointmentId)}`. The legacy 404 fallback to status proposal and status-confirm has been excised. Any failure or non-OK response sets a terminal failed outcome and proceeds immediately to fresh reconciliation without calling status endpoints, the hyphenated alias, or raw `DELETE`.
- **Challenge 3 (Shared Proposal Validator):** In [`docs/diary/diary.js`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r197/docs/diary/diary.js#L9638-L9686), `validateDeleteProposalForConfirmation()` binds `appointment_id`, allowlisted `status_reason_code`, optional `cancellation_reason` (<=500 chars), recursive issue validation (`validDeleteConfirmIssue`), exact command matching, `intent === "delete_appointment"`, `requires_confirmation === true`, exact autonomy tier (`proposal` vs `blocked`), and canonical endpoint `/appointments/proposals/delete/confirm`.
- **Challenge 4 (Mandatory Visible Confirmation):** In [`docs/diary/diary.js`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r197/docs/diary/diary.js#L10559-L10571), `showStatusProposalDialog(proposal)` is displayed. Staff cancellation (clicking cancel or pressing Escape) resolves to `false`, causing the flow to treat the action as unconfirmed and skip confirmation execution entirely without issuing any confirm HTTP request.
- **Challenge 5 (Canonical Endpoint & Minimal Public Receipt):** [`applySignedDeleteProposal()`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r197/docs/diary/diary.js#L11057-L11090) validates the proposal, POSTs only to canonical `/appointments/proposals/delete/confirm` with `deleteConfirmIdempotencyKey`, and validates the response through [`validateDeleteConfirmPublicEnvelope()`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r197/docs/diary/diary.js#L9688-L9746). The envelope validator enforces `raisa.delete_confirm_public_envelope.v1`, minimal receipt `appointment.delete_confirmation_receipt.v1`, and explicitly rejects any `appointment` read-model object or private receipt fields.
- **Challenge 6 (Reconciliation via Fresh Authorized Read):** [`reconcileOrdinaryCancellation()`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r197/docs/diary/diary.js#L10458-L10471) executes `await loadDiary(true)` after all outcomes (success, replay, block, denial, transport uncertainty, non-OK, or malformed responses). No optimistic cache modification or appointment deletion is performed.
- **Challenge 7 (Current Appointment Defeats Success Claim):** When `loadDiary(true)` reconciles and finds the appointment still active/un-cancelled ([`docs/diary/diary.js`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r197/docs/diary/diary.js#L10610-L10617)), any receipt success claim is defeated, displaying `"A cancellation receipt was returned, but the current Diary still shows this appointment. Success has not been assumed; review current truth before trying again."` and requiring a new proposal.
- **Challenge 8 (Reconciliation Failure Handling):** If `loadDiary(true)` fails (`refreshed !== true`), [`setOrdinaryCancellationRefreshRequired()`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r197/docs/diary/diary.js#L10447-L10456) sets `data-refresh-required="true"`, disables the delete control with `"Refresh Required"`, and keeps the modal open without making any success or non-commit claim.
- **Challenge 9 (Review and Smoke Suite Execution):** Command C04 executed the review test suite and encountered 2 test failures, exiting with code 1:
  1. `review/test_reception_one_cancellation_action.py::test_staff_escape_cancels_without_confirm_and_retains_truth`: Failed activeElement evaluation assertion on line 633 following Escape press.
  2. `review/test_diary_smoke.py::test_bernie_review_route_intercepted_blocked`: Playwright timeout (15000ms) waiting for locator `.diary-column`.
- **Challenge 10 (AER-0391 Provenance):** Verified [`docs/ariadne-agent-error-correction-register-revision-344.md`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r197/docs/ariadne-agent-error-correction-register-revision-344.md) and [`orchestration/agent_inbox/deepseek/raisa-ordinary-diary-cancellation-canonical-consumer-convergence-composition-first-transport-failure.json`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r197/orchestration/agent_inbox/deepseek/raisa-ordinary-diary-cancellation-canonical-consumer-convergence-composition-first-transport-failure.json). AER-0391 accurately preserves the isolated DeepSeek exit-1 transport non-result at frozen source `967ac705bad2013734beaed127cd5e811823d2c7` and records Sol's fallback without worker attribution.

No backend, API Spine, OpenAPI, schema, migration, or database files were modified.
